title: Map Google enrollment UI fields to source-specific commands

findings.evidence: Host compares JSON.stringify(identity.fields) to gmailFields() without sort. CLI sorts both. CLI order is text,subjects,headers,labels,attachments; connector stored order is text,subjects,attachments,headers,labels. Replica verify-field-map.json fieldOrderMismatch.host_stringify_equal=false, cli_sorted_equal=true.
findings.affected_invariant: Reauthorization must preserve selected fields; order of the same set must not become identity_conflict.
findings.required_fix: P042/implementer: sort or canonicalize field arrays on the host identity check, matching CLI. Do not treat this as a UI default-path bug: client.js always sends new_source true.

findings.evidence: googleCalendarId(undefined) throws Error; failure() maps unknown Error to unavailable (retryable). Empty string fails string() as invalid_request.
findings.affected_invariant: Ambiguous or missing Calendar identity should refuse as invalid request, not as a retryable host outage.
findings.required_fix: Classify missing/primary calendar as AppFailure('invalid_request') before the generic Error path.

findings.evidence: Field/calendar parsers throw Error, so dispatch returns 1. UsageError (exclusive flags, wrong --calendar, TTY) returns 2.
findings.affected_invariant: Exit 2 is usage; callers must not assume invalid --fields is usage.
findings.required_fix: None required for P042 mapping; preserve the distinction.
